purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: PULSE public viewer advertises a Kasur cadastral polygon layer. Anonymous reader bootstrap succeeded in memory. Layer 13 metadata HTTP 200 identifies Kasur polygons in EPSG:3857, with safe native OBJECTID available; metadata had 27 fields, but no private field names/values were retained. Requests used only outFields=OBJECTID plus geometry. A bounded 0.001-degree locator cell, eight adjacent cells, and one ~0.72 km² window all returned complete empty FeatureCollections. No polygon sample was retained. Viewer’s indicative-line disclaimer is informational about legal use, not an access/schema gate.
registryAssessment: Punjab PULSE’s official public viewer lists Kasur under Cadastral Maps. The official Punjab PULSE project describes parcel mapping linked to provincial land records. Kasur is therefore a city/district-specific cadastral source candidate, but these sources do not imply citywide coverage or exact WUP-point parcel presence.
